research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Code42 is focused on developing systems for data loss protection and recovery by monitoring file system element transfers and detecting data exfiltration through applications. Their research includes forensic file services that adjust data according to database schemas and user behavior analytics to identify insider threats. They also work on detecting suspicious file activity and delivering security content based on user personas. These efforts aim to enhance data visibility and protection across networked environments.

overview_description.description: Code42 provides data loss protection, visibility, and recovery solutions. Its data loss protection solution rapidly detects insider threats, satisfies regulatory compliance requirements and speeds incident response, all without lengthy deployments, complex policy management or blocks on user collaboration. Its security, IT and compliance professionals can protect endpoint and cloud data from loss, leak and theft while maintaining an open and collaborative culture for employees.

product.name: Incydr
product.description: A SaaS solution that provides visibility and protection against data leak and theft by monitoring file activity across endpoints and cloud services.

product.name: Incydr Flows
product.description: Automates actions between Incydr and other corporate systems for increased effectiveness in incident response without requiring code.

product.name: Code42 API
product.description: Enables custom reports, automated actions, and integration with existing systems to enhance Insider Risk programs.

product.name: Incydr Exfiltration Detector for Salesforce
product.description: Detects and prevents source code exfiltrations to untrusted repositories, safeguarding proprietary information.

product.name: Incydr + Splunk Integration
product.description: Allows for the correlation and analysis of Insider Risk data within Splunk through a command-line interface integration.

product.name: Remote Workforce Data Protection
product.description: Monitors file activity for remote users, providing visibility into untrusted data activities and differentiating between remote and in-network activity.
